The '''Imperial Science Bureau''', also known as the '''Imperial Science Department''' and the '''Imperial Science Division''', was a [[Science/Legends|scientific]] organization of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
The Imperial Science Department was an organization dedicated to the study and research of weapons and developing new inventions for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], it tracked the rare [[Spice/Legends|spice]] known as [[Karrak/Legends|karrak]], which suppressed [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] of an individual for forty-eight [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] of the Bureau attempted to refine, duplicate, and reverse engineer the properties of karrak, while the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] began developing improved forms of the spice and distributed it to [[Agent/Legends|agents]] that were hunting fugitive [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals.<ref name="Endless Vigil" />

One of the most disastrous results of this organization was the [[Death/Legends|extinction]] of all living creatures on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kiva]] at the hands of [[Mammon Hoole]].
